header:
Awesome Sales and Lead Generation

> Open-source CRM, outreach, enrichment, scraping and pipeline tools for sales teams and solo founders. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Follow anti-spam law.** CAN-SPAM, GDPR and similar rules apply to outreach.
- **Scraped data has terms.** Check the source's terms and your local privacy law.
- **Warm up sending domains** and keep lists clean.
- **Review AI messages** before they go out under your name.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
